about:
Palmetto Cabling Solutions operates from Rock Hill, South Carolina, where its office staff brings together more than 40 years of combined experience in communications infrastructure. The company deploys traveling project managers and technicians to serve clients across all 50 states.

The firm delivers a full range of low-voltage installation services, including structured cabling, fiber optic cable installation, WiFi deployment, and CATV/IPTV systems. It acts as a single-source contractor, handling engineering and design, material procurement, installation, and final testing of network systems for projects ranging from small offices to multi-story buildings.

Its customer base spans education, government, healthcare, industrial, commercial, and professional or collegiate stadium sectors. The company designs customized IP-based solutions for communications and security needs in each of these verticals.

Palmetto Cabling Solutions emphasizes quick response times and quality assurance as key differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that can take a project from concept through completion with a single point of accountability.
